scripts.//audit:release: THE FREE LOCAL REPLACEMENT for .github/workflows/quality-gate.yml and lighthouse-ci.yml, both deleted 2026-09-01. Those two burned ~15 billed Actions minutes a week auditing the LEGACY root tree at URLs the live site 404s (/pricing.html, /contact.html) and had failed 18 consecutive runs since 2026-08-05. This runs axe-core over all 45 shipped astro/ routes and Lighthouse over one route per page template, on this machine, for zero Actions minutes. It is DELIBERATELY NOT WIRED INTO CI: under RULE 0-G wiring a gate into CI turns a free script into a blocking billable one and needs the owner's explicit approval. Do not add a workflow for it without asking. It never reads a Lighthouse exit code (chrome-launcher exits 1 on a clean audit on Windows because it cannot delete its temp profile) and it refuses to measure any route that does not land on itself with a 200.
